subject: Preflight: GCP Private Listing tech validation + co-sell 'bumper' agreement
messages:
From: Amit Rao <amit@cloudlogic.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <procurement@cloudlogic.com>
Date: Sat, 04 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick preflight for GCP private listing and co-sell bump

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our leadership liked the low-latency routing story and wants to move this to a Private Listing on GCP with a co-sell uplift. Before we open the internal marketplace request, can you confirm two things: (1) a short tech preflight checklist we can pass to our infra team (VPC peering / IAP / service account scopes / billing SKUs), and (2) whether Redwood is comfortable with a brief co-sell "bumper" agreement that guarantees lead routing for 6 months (we can share a template).

If easier, propose a 30-min slot early next week — we want to align procurement and engineering.

Best,
Amit
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudLogic

Attachments: none

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Rao <amit@cloudlogic.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 04 May 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick preflight for GCP private listing and co-sell bump

Amit — thanks for the quick follow. High level answers inline and attaching an annotated runbook and a starter co-sell bumper draft. Key items for your infra team:

- VPC peering / Private Service Connect: required for demo tenant access; we'll provide CIDR suggestions in the runbook.
- IAP & OAuth scopes: IAP for secure console links; service account with roles/iam.serviceAccountUser and monitoring.viewer for telemetry.
- Billing SKUs: you can choose Private Offer SKU or managed listing SKU; procurement checklist attached.
- Entitlement & metering: recommend meter at usage-level + monthly invoice; we support meter hooks via gcp-metering-shim (details in runbook).

On the co-sell bumper: the attached draft is intentionally lightweight — lead routing, basic SLAs on response, and a 6-month evaluation. Naomi can shepherd commercial terms and Ben can scope the technical gating for co-sell eligibility.

Propose Monday 2029-05-06 10:00 PT for a 30-min preflight call. If that works I will send a calendar invite with the runbook link.

-Jasmine
Director, Alliances
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-gcp-runbook-annotated.pdf; co-sell-bumper-draft.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Rao <amit@cloudlogic.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 May 2029 10:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick preflight for GCP private listing and co-sell bump

On Mon, May 6, 2029 at 10:05 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Propose Monday 2029-05-06 10:00 PT for a 30-min preflight call.

Thanks all — joined from the engineering side. Quick technical clarifications so we don't block your infra schedule:

1) Demo tenant networking — we recommend using a dedicated subnet per environment and enforcing egress through a NAT gateway; the runbook has the YAML for the demo-tenant-config (attached).
2) KV cache and latency testing — we'll need a representative payload (10–20 requests/s for 5 minutes) to verify tail latencies under the Private Listing config. Can you provision that load or want Redwood to run it?
3) Metering hooks — CloudLogic's billing system will need the metering webhook URL; Naomi, can your procurement team confirm acceptance of monthly aggregated telemetry vs per-token reporting?

If you prefer we can run an initial smoke test in our staging project later this week.

-Karthik
Sr. Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-tenant-config.yaml

From: Amit Rao <amit@cloudlogic.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <procurement@cloudlogic.com>
Date: Wed, 08 May 2029 02:14:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Quick preflight for GCP private listing and co-sell bump

Thanks Karthik —

We can provision the 10–20 rps load for the smoke test on Thursday in our staging project; I will have infra create the subnet/NAT per your recommendations. Priya (CC) — procurement is OK with month-aggregated telemetry for the pilot, but we need sample fields and retention window to confirm with legal.

Also, attached is our external counsel's suggested edit to section 3 of the bumper draft — they want a modified non-solicit carve-out. Sharing for Redwood legal eyes. Can you point me to who will own contract redlines?

Cheers,
Amit
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudLogic

Attachments: cloudlogic-legal-redlines-section3.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Rao <amit@cloudlogic.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 May 2029 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick preflight for GCP private listing and co-sell bump

Amit — appreciated. Naomi here (commercial). I'll pick up the redlines and loop Legal + Revenue Ops. Quick answers:

- Metering telemetry fields: account_id, timestamp_utc, sku_id, usage_units, aggregated_total_month — retention 13 months default (can shorten if required).
- Contract redlines: send the PDF to legal@redwood.ai; I will steward and come back within 48 hours with a negotiated edit.
- Go/no-go schedule: if smoke test passes on Thursday, we aim to submit the Private Listing package to GCP by Friday COB PT. That keeps us on the board for their next co-sell cycle.

I'll coordinate a short triage call with Legal and Revenue Ops if redlines look material. Jasmine — please go ahead and lock the Monday calendar invite as a placeholder; we'll update once we confirm final times.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Head of Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Quoted earlier messages preserved for thread context.
